description:
Record the person’s answer to whether a result was what they wanted, the same as Yes, Close and No in the app: `yes` (a match), `close` (nearly) or `no` (not a match), with an optional note on what was right or wrong. It guides future matching for that alert; it does not change the brief or recheck earlier results. Rate again to change the answer. Only send the person’s own answer.

Permission: alerts:write.

note.description: Optional: what Poacher got right or wrong.

rating.description: `yes` = a match, `close` = nearly, `no` = not a match.

result_id.description: Result ID from list_results or get_result.

name: rate_result
title: Rate a result
